title: Missing moeb tool: absolute-path file read for start_run overflow output
description: start_run produced 197,841 chars of output exceeding the MCP response limit; the kernel saved it to a temp file at an absolute path outside the working directory. No moeb tool supports reading files at arbitrary absolute paths, requiring the external Read tool. This recurs whenever start_run output is large.
proposed_resolution: Add a moeb tool (or extend start_run) to page large output within the MCP protocol rather than saving to a temp file, or introduce a read_overflow_file tool that reads the kernel-generated temp file by run_id.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
